name: Question 4
worked_solution:
We can apply the distributive law

$$
BA+BC=B(A+C).
$$

So, we calculate $A+C$ first:

$$
\begin{aligned}A+C & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 & -1 \\ 4 & -2 & 3 \\ -5 & 1 & 2\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-1 & 3 & 1 \\ -4 & 2 & -3 \\ 5 & -1 & -2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}BA+BC & =B(A+C) \\  & =[\begin{aligned}8 & \sqrt{3} & \sqrt{7} \\ \sqrt{5} & \sqrt{6} & \sqrt{2} \\ \sqrt{7} & \sqrt{2} & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
